newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland Cranberries rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland Cranberries rating cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it cut its long-term rating on Northland Cranberries Inc to market perform from outperform.
-- EVEREN said price appreciation is the sole reason for the cut.
-- "The stock has experienced a remarkable run since our initial rating change on April 4, 1996, to (outperform), from a split-adjusted price of $11.75," EVEREN analyst Richard Elam said in a report.
-- Northland shares traded Friday morning at 23-3/8, down 1/8.
-- Elam said demand for Northland's juices remains strong, and products are now available in Los Angeles and other West Coast markets.

-- He said he continues to expect gains in sales and earnings, with projections of earnings of $0.70 a share in fiscal 1997 and $0.95 in fiscal 1998. Northland earned $0.50 a share in fiscal 1996, ended August 31.
-- EVEREN's price objectives are $24 a share for the next six months and $26 for 18 months.
